name: response_ir_chat_stream_usage_anthropic
_comment: Chat-stream authoritative usage with cache share toward Anthropic SSE: identical upstream script as the Responses/Gemini siblings. Placeholder input_tokens 0 at message_start, terminal message_delta corrects to input 12-4=8 with cache_read 4 and output 7 (Chat prompt is inclusive; Anthropic excludes the cached bucket). Post-commit terminal; no [DONE] on Anthropic.
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "bridge-chat"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o-mini"
